tasks.instruction: Repair MiniMax cover-reference base64 validation so it does not decode, re-encode, normalize, or copy the complete audio payload. In worker/minimax-music.ts export inspectMiniMaxCoverBase64(value: unknown): Readonly<{ decodedBytes: number }>, returning a frozen object with only decodedBytes, and use it in prepareMiniMaxMusic for the audio_base64 branch. Preserve the original request/body identity. Accept nonempty canonical standard base64 with decoded size at most 8 MiB, including exact-limit input. Reject non-string values, whitespace, URL-safe alphabet, interior/excess padding, nonzero unused padding bits and oversize input, including max-plus-one inputs with the same encoded length as valid max input. Use bounded scalar inspection without atob/btoa or allocating a payload-sized decoded/normalized copy. Preserve existing invalid_minimax_music_text or invalid_minimax_music_audio_base64 errors and all unrelated URL, region, request and streaming behavior.
